dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' geometries with high-intensity greyish-white perimeters surrounding low-intensity dark centers; transition is abrupt on exterior edges and more diffuse toward the interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse distribution of asymmetrical, non-gradient high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the neck region and scattered between major annuli structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-body annuli form an irregular scalene triangle; secondary clusters on the dorsal-lateral ridge form a localized rectangular group.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated patterning where high-intensity edges of adjacent macro-annuli converge to form a continuous grid-like lattice across the central dorsal-lateral surface.
